review_description: Bob was incredible with his knowledge of the product. I was unsure if wanting it until I sat down with him and I am so glad his confidence in the product and his company made me say yes.My electricity bills have gone from between $380/$500 per month running our pool for 8 hours everyday to $79 per month.Thank a million Bob for such great service and k owing exactly what we needed.Would recommend solar spirit to everyone and please ask for Bob, you won’t be disappointed

Excellent service provided by Solar Spirit Melbourne, specially Mandeep. Ours was a complicated job due to the location of the switchboard and its distance from the garage for a new build in Wollert, but Mandeep and team came up with an ingenious, elegant and cheap solution to get around the issue and installed the sub-board and inverter at a very convenient location around the property using underground cabling. Communication was always prompt and Mandeep was very helpful and patient in answering all our questions, guiding us through the process and dealing with the constant changes and wait times that come with a new house.Even with additional work involved, got the most reasonable quote for a 13.2KW system with Jinko panels laid out in 3 directions, and a Sungrow battery-ready inverter. Installers were efficient, polite, on-time and did a very clean job. Got it turned on in 3 days and already producing way more than we can consume. Will happily recommend Solar Spirit and Mandeep.
